name: watch the road
source:
You're a trucker, built for solitude and bad weather. But tonight's storm is worse than usual, and you're spent. Then, out of the white, a lone figure emerges – asking for help.

Will you pull over? Or keep driving into the unknown?

[From [url=https://mariengel.itch.io/watch-the-road]Itch.io[/url]]
